title: us-evolution-education-lpm Policy Principle Record
description: A modular, OpenEvo-authored policy principle -- the compilable unit that policy briefs and other outreach materials are built from. Distinct from local_policy/lp records: those describe external institutional facts (verificationStatus); this describes OUR authored position, grounded in those facts via groundedIn, using the ordinary ecosystem review_status lifecycle instead of a verification status. Identical shape to deutsche_lp's policy-principle-record.schema.json.

domain.description: Which of the two key policy domains this principle belongs to.

jurisdictionScope.description: 'US' for a multi-state/federal-level principle (lives in national_ccs_policy/), a specific state code for a state-adapted version (lives in state/<state>/ccs_policy/).

adaptedFrom.description: If this is a state-level adaptation of a national/multi-state principle, its id.

statement.description: The principle itself, written as something that could appear in a policy brief.

groundedIn.description: Ids of local_policy/lp records (institutional actors, timeline events, curriculum crosswalks, mandates, coherence findings, policy controversies) this principle is grounded in or responds to. This principle's practical credibility is only as strong as the weakest verificationStatus among these.

designPrinciples.description: Loose, informal references to OpenEvo's Educational Design Concept design principles (not yet validated against a formal schema/repo).

contentAnchors.description: Loose, informal references to OpenEvo's nine content anchors, where relevant.

conceptRefs.description: Loose, informal references to ConceptBase OE-CONCEPT-* ids (not yet a validated cross-repo link).
